expected_issues.title: NodeKeywords iteration and len() count duplicate keys
expected_issues.description:
__iter__ now yields keys of the node and of its parent without de-duplication, and __len__ adds both sizes, so keywords present at both levels are counted twice.

NodeKeywords is a MutableMapping view merging node markers with the parent's keywords; the removed set-based `_seen()` existed precisely to remove duplicates (e.g. a marker applied at class and function level, or the module name). The micro-optimisation makes iteration yield duplicates and len() over-count, breaking mapping invariants (len(k) != len(set(k))) and affects plugins iterating keywords.
